exposure: preterm birth at 26 weeks of gestation
suspected sequelae of grade II germinal matrix bleed
outcome: cystic lesions along the germinal matrix
cohort: A single preterm neonate born at 26 weeks gestation as part of a diamniotic dichorionic twin pregnancy, complicated by placental abruption and necessitating an urgent cesarean section.
finding: The case describes a preterm neonate who developed widespread periventricular cystic lesions, consistent with cystic periventricular leukomalacia, after initial abnormal transcranial ultrasound findings suggesting sequelae of a grade II germinal matrix bleed.
